## Bio

I am currently an Assistant Professor Mathematics and the director of the data science program at [Southern Utah University](https://www.suu.edu/math/) where I teach primarily statistics and data science courses.

I received a Bachelor's of Science in Mathematics with an option in Statistics from [California State University, Chico](https://www.csuchico.edu/academics/college/natural-sciences/departments/mathematics-statistics/), a Master's of Science in Statistics from [Colorado State University](https://statistics.colostate.edu) and a PhD in Applied Mathematics from the [University of Montana](https://www.umt.edu/math/). I worked as a Mathematical Statistician for the [United States Census Bureau ](https://www.census.gov) between obtaining my master's and going back to graduate school for my PhD.
